_readme: Spike 0 bookings for scripts/spikes/flight-status-spike.mts. EVERY flight number, date, time and airport below is a PLACEHOLDER: replace each with a real, public, upcoming flight before running live (dates inside AeroDataBox's window, ideally within the next few days so live fields appear). Booking refs are invented and must stay invented: no real PNRs, names or card details in this repo. Keep the five SHAPES: bare number + carried code on the 2nd sector of a multi-stop number, a spaced lower-case number on an overnight flight, a name-only airline with name-only airports, a codeshare marketing number, and a multi-stop number booked end to end.

bookings.shape: bare number '25' + 'Singapore Airlines (SQ)'; booked on the SECOND sector of multi-stop SQ25 (FRA→JFK)
spaced lower-case 'sq 318', no airline; overnight arrival (next day)
name-only airline and name-only airports (the name-match path)
codeshare: a MARKETING number operated by another airline (replace with a real one)
multi-stop SQ25 booked END TO END (SIN→JFK via FRA): arrival half from the 2nd sector
